Other segments show typical noise or smooth motion without clear morphological anomalies.

Broad apparent platform in N and E from ~635 to 665 (≈20 samples), where both components stabilize near zero after prior variability; U shows a shallow dip (~−1 MAD) centered at 650 with ambiguous return—possible opposing or delayed response, not clearly resolved at this scale.
